name: attentive-notify
description: Send completed Codex and Claude Code responses to an Attentive notifier.

interface.shortDescription: Notify Attentive when Codex or Claude Code finishes a response.
interface.longDescription: Forwards each non-empty Stop response from Codex or Claude Code to the configured Attentive notifier and derives a useful title from the session.
interface.defaultPrompt: Send an Attentive notification when the current coding task finishes.
